description: This file is a Java source file implementing the OrderService interface for handling order processing, calculation, invoice generation, and order status management in an e-commerce system.

classes.name: OrderServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the OrderService interface managing order lifecycle, calculation, invoicing, and status updates for an e-commerce platform.

methods.name: addOrderStatusHistory
methods.description: Adds a new status history record to an order.

methods.name: processOrder
methods.description: Processes an order by handling payment, setting status, and saving order details.

methods.name: caculateOrderTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total summary of an order, including items, shipping, taxes, and totals.

methods.name: caculateOrder
methods.description: Performs detailed order total calculations based on order summary and related data.

methods.name: calculateShoppingCartTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total of the shopping cart, updating item prices and totals.

methods.name: generateInvoice
methods.description: Creates an invoice document for a given order.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Retrieves an order by its ID.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists all orders associated with a specific merchant store.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new order or updates an existing order in the database.

methods.name: hasDownloadFiles
methods.description: Checks if an order contains downloadable files.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes an order from the system.
